headline: Meta is building glasses without cameras
standfirst: The company is pivoting its AI hardware strategy to focus on lighter, longer-lasting

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: Meta is developing a new version of its smart glasses that will not include a camera.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: The company is moving away from camera-heavy hardware to prioritize comfort and battery life.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: These glasses will be lighter and offer up to 12 hours of battery life per charge.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Keep an eye on how users react to AI glasses that prioritize long usage over visual recording.

caption:
Meta is working on new AI glasses that ditch the camera to focus on battery life and weight.

By removing the camera, Meta aims to create a more comfortable device that can last all day. This shift suggests the company is betting on voice and AI assistance over visual capture.

Would you wear smart glasses if they couldn't take photos?
